I think Voat's spam problem comes down to two things:

  • Community size
  • Vigilance

Because Voat is relatively small it doesn't take a large population of spammers to seem overwhelming. Proportionally the amount of spam on Reddit might actually be more than here on Voat, but it's diluted among more genuine users. This brings me to my second point, vigilance.

Voat has fewer moderators, and an even smaller staff. Authorities are proverbially under-gunned. Also, although new users are prevented from arbitrarily downvoating, this very mechanism also neuters the ability for new genuine users to help stem the tide. It arguably might disenchant them as well and contribute to early abandonment, but that's a different issue.

For right now, I don't think there will be a solution to the spam issues. We're overrun becasue we don't have enough people manning the front-lines.
